evidence.evidence_text: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have become incredibly popular, with ChatGPT for example being used by over a billion users.
In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have become incredibly popular, with ChatGPT for example being used by over a billion users.

While these models exhibit remarkable language understanding and logical prowess, a notable challenge surfaces in the form of "hallucinations." This phenomenon results in LLMs outputting misinformation in a confident manner, which can lead to devastating consequences with such a large user base.
